noveltyJustification: Four findings are new (route schema, compatibility switch, default-row lever, fail-closed gap); three extend facts the resource map already recorded.
answeredQuestions: How are providers, models and reasoning levels configured, and can LLM Gateway and OpenCode Go be added as closed, fail-closed routes?
ruledOut: Relying on the harness catalog to enforce a model allowlist

label: A custom OpenAI-compatible route is a llm-pi-ai row with providers.<id> naming apiKeyEnv, one of three api protocols, baseURL and a non-empty models list; the provider id is permanent, lowercase and hyphenated, and one provider speaks one protocol.

LLM Gateway is expressible as provider llmgateway, api openai-completions, baseURL https://api.llmgateway.io/v1, model deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017, with compat.supportsDeveloperRole false and the bare (not provider-prefixed) model id.

OpenCode Go is expressible as provider opencode-go, api openai-completions, baseURL https://opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1, model deepseek-v4.1-flash; declaration does not imply reachability, since its 2026-11-05 smoke failed overloaded.

Reasoning levels are declared per model as reasoningEfforts mapping a level to its reasoning_effort wire spelling; max is a real level, DeepSeek's built-in route offers off/low/high/max, a hand-declared model has none until declared, and unsupported selections fail with UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT.
DeepSeek V4 behind an OpenAI-compatible gateway needs compat.thinkingFormat deepseek so off sends thinking disabled and other levels send thinking enabled beside the effort.
apiKeyEnv is a credential reference resolved per request, keeping secrets out of config; failures carry stable codes MISSING_CREDENTIAL, INVALID_CREDENTIAL, UNKNOWN_MODEL, QUOTA and RATE_LIMIT.

The shipped default route is agent-default-model with provider deepseek-official and model deepseek-flash; a --patch overlay can replace that row with provider, model and reasoningEffort, which is the per-dispatch route lever a --model flag would have provided.

Fail-closed enforcement is only partly native: the adapter refuses an unconfigured model id but agent-default-model does not validate catalog membership, so a closed roster needs the skill packet and dispatch preflight guard to pin provider and model.

direction: A --model or --provider dispatch flag on dsh headless
reason: The installed help exposes no model or provider option; selection is profile config.

direction: Relying on the harness to enforce a model allowlist
reason: Only profile-declared routes are validated, and agent-default-model does not check catalog membership.
